post.summary:
Records that a title or person page was opened, as opening its web page
does; the other `/api/…` reads never count. Answers with the new list.

App.description: Apps whose titles say which episode is playing.

Availability.description: Which of the user's services include a title on the To watch list.

state.description: Of the title's offers: stale or unavailable when TMDB couldn't be reached.

services.description: In TMDB's order; empty when unavailable.

Detection.description: An episode or movie seen playing, as stored.

tmdb_id.description: The TMDB show or movie it was matched to.

DetectionStatus.description: How an episode seen playing has been handled.

title.description: TMDB's name, or "Episode N" when it has none.

oneOf.description: IMDb's episode score; None when IMDb has none or ratings are unavailable.

EpisodeDetail.description: One TV episode with everyone credited on it.

title.description: TMDB's name, or "Episode N" when it has none.

oneOf.description: IMDb's episode score; None when IMDb has none or ratings are unavailable.

episode_ratings.description: Where `rating` came from, and why it's missing if it is.

key_crew.description: Directors and writers of this episode.

cast.description: Series regulars who appear in this episode, in billing order.

previous.description: Neighbouring episode numbers within the season, for navigation.

apple_tv.description: Marked from what played on an Apple TV.

EpisodeRatings.description: Provenance of a season's per-episode IMDb ratings.

imdb_id.description: The show's IMDb identifier, which the season was looked up by.

EpisodeWithWatched.description: An episode with its show's watched marks.

role.description: Characters for acting credits, job titles otherwise.

oneOf.description:
When sorted by rating: the score it was sorted by, Rotten Tomatoes if
there is one, else IMDb.
To watch only, once services are chosen: which of them include it.
Lists only: whether it's saved and watched.

in_theaters.description:
To watch and Favorites only: a movie playing in the region's
theaters now. Omitted when not.

FilmographySort.description: How a person's filmography is ordered within each department.

Kind.description: Whether something seen playing is a TV episode or a movie.

ListServices.description: What stood behind the To watch list's service badges.

unknown.description: Titles whose offers couldn't be loaded.

stale_since.description: Oldest fetch among offers served stale because TMDB failed.

ListedBody.description: Puts a title on a list or takes it off.

oneOf.description: Lost or never made since `since`; retrying.

LiveStatus.description: The live feed from Home Assistant's WebSocket.

Metadata.description: How current the TMDB data behind a response is.

MovieWithMarks.description: A movie with whether it's saved and watched.

PendingShow.description:
A show whose episodes, or a movie, wait for the user to pick its TMDB
show or movie.

note.description: Why it wasn't matched, from its latest episode.

episodes.description: "S1 E3" for each waiting episode; empty for a movie.

candidates.description: TMDB shows or movies found by name; `None` if TMDB couldn't be searched.

PersonCredit.description: A person's part in one title: a character for cast, job titles for crew.

episode_count.description:
TV only: episodes this person is credited on. Left out for cast until
the show is watched as a whole (see `hide_cast_episode_counts`).

known_for_titles.description: The person's most-voted titles, from their main department first.

filmography.description: Grouped by department, the person's main department first.

oneOf.description:
How complete the credits' scores are (behind the order, when sorted
by rating). Always present.

known_for.description: The few titles TMDB associates with the person, most notable first.

status.description: The last read of Home Assistant's history.

players.description: Players read, by Home Assistant entity ID.

other.description:
Time spent playing other things since the server started, by app,
most first.

score.description: Out of `scale`: IMDb is 0–10, the Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer 0–100 (%).

RatingSource.description:
Where a score comes from. Each source has its own scale; never compare
raw scores across sources (see `Rating::percent`).

provider.description: Always `omdb` today; scores' own origins are in `Rating::source`.

oneOf.description: None when the preferred source has no score; never substituted.

others.description: Scores from non-preferred sources, each labeled with its source.

RecentKind.description:
Which kind of page a recently viewed entry links to: "movie", "tv" or
"person".

RecentView.description: A title or person page as listed under "Recently viewed" on the home page.

RecentViews.description: Recently opened title and person pages, most recent first.

upcoming.description: Whether the date is after today.

Releases.description: When a movie comes out in the configured region, from TMDB.

region.description: The ISO 3166-1 region the dates and certification are for.

dates.description:
In theaters, digital, then physical, each its earliest date. When the
region has none of those, just TMDB's primary release date.

SearchHit.description:
One search result. Serialized with a `kind` of "movie", "tv" or "person"
alongside the variant's fields.

episode_ratings.description: Where the episodes' `rating`s came from, and why they're missing if they are.

oneOf.description: Neighbouring seasons in the show's season order, for navigation.

SeasonWithWatched.description: A season with its show's watched marks.

Service.description: A streaming service, as TMDB lists it.

ServiceGroup.description: Where a service appears on the services page, in page order.

ServicesDetail.description: The services page: the user's choice and every service to choose from.

options.description:
In group order, alphabetical within each group, without add-on
channels the user hasn't chosen. Only the chosen ones when TMDB's list
is unavailable.

complete.description: False when only one of TMDB's movie and TV lists could be loaded.

ServicesState.description: Whether the user's streaming services are known.

ShowProgress.description:
What of a TV show is marked watched. Marks are independent, so episodes
may also lie within marked seasons.

show.description: The whole show, every season included.

seasons.description: Seasons marked one at a time, ascending.

episodes.description: How many episodes are marked one at a time.

SortRatings.description:
What stood behind a list's scores (and a by-rating order): credits
without a score, and whether some scores were stale or couldn't be loaded.

stale_since.description: Oldest fetch among scores served stale because OMDb failed.

oneOf.description: Set when ratings aren't configured or some lookups failed outright.

SyncStatus.description: How reading Home Assistant is going.

TitleCredits.description: Everyone credited on a title, crew grouped by department.

oneOf.description: Movies only; `None` when TMDB has no dates at all.

in_theaters.description:
Movies only: playing in the region's theaters now (see
`Catalog::in_theaters`).

showtimes_url.description:
Movies in theaters only: where to look up showtimes (see
`showtimes_url`).

key_crew.description: Directors and writers (movies), creators and principal directors (TV).

cast.description: Top-billed cast only; the full list is in `TitleCredits`.

season_list.description: TV only, regular seasons first and specials (season 0) last.

in_theaters.description: Movies only: playing in the region's theaters now.

TitleMarks.description:
Whether a title is on To watch and Favorites and marked watched (a TV
show as a whole). Each is `null` when it couldn't be read.

TitleMarksUpdate.description:
A title's marks after a change. TV shows also carry the show's watched
marks, since favoriting one marks its aired seasons.

TvWithWatched.description: A TV show with its watched marks.

ViewedBody.description: A title or person page a client opened.

WatchedList.description:
Every movie and TV show with a watched mark, however it was made: by
hand, by favoriting a show, or from what played on an Apple TV.

unavailable.description: Titles whose name, year and poster couldn't be loaded from TMDB.

stale_since.description: Oldest fetch among title details served stale because TMDB failed.

WatchedMarks.description:
A TV show's watched marks as the JSON API reports them, so a client can
hide spoilers the way the pages do.

show.description: The whole show, every season included.

seasons.description: Seasons marked one at a time, ascending.

episodes.description: Episodes marked one at a time, ascending.

WatchedSort.description: How the Watched list is ordered.

title.description: `null` when TMDB couldn't be reached and nothing was cached.

last_watched_at.description: When the latest of its marks was made.

sources.description: How its marks were made; at least one.

WatchlistDetail.description: The "To watch" list: saved movies and TV shows in the chosen order.

oneOf.description: Only when sorted by rating: how complete the scores behind the order are.
To watch only: the user's services and how complete the titles' offers are.

WatchlistSort.description: How the "To watch" list is ordered.

WhereToWatch.description: How a title can be watched in one region, from TMDB's JustWatch data.

link.description: TMDB's page of every offer in the region, which links on to each service.

offers.description:
Non-empty groups, in `OfferKind` order. Empty when nothing is offered
in the region, or when unavailable.
